DESCRIPTION:
   

  

 The Data Scientist may be responsible for any of the following tasks: Analyzing data that is collected in our current and future products and services, Develop statistical and machine learning models using state of the art Machine Learning and AI technologies, Visualize insights for business actions and collaborate with Software Developers to implement into our products and services. The Data Scientist would need to be able to apply the data analysis, models, and software to the markets our products are in for us to better serve our customers. The Data Scientist must have good communication and organization skills, along with a working knowledge of day\-to\-day operations and priorities within their department and the company. Assume other duties as assigned.
   

  

 Now offering a 4\.5\-day workweek!
